It's a new year but our work remains the same! It's time to:
🔘 protect voting rights
🔘 pass the #BuildBackBetter Act
🔘 expand women's healthcare access
Let's get it done!
COVID-19 cases are on the rise across Michigan. Please, get vaccinated, get boosted, and get tested if you've been exposed or are experiencing symptoms. https://t.co/pIUlLyULbq
Open Enrollment ends TODAY, Jan. 15th. Sign up today to #GetCovered at https://t.co/WZjVcKI6MY before the deadline.  https://t.co/y90BLVYD9Y https://t.co/iegzZYzw7R
We love to see it! Thanks to the #AmericanRescuePlan, we lowered health care costs and hundreds of thousands of Michiganders now have health insurance.https://t.co/p6VP28t9fB

Today is National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, a day to address the impact of HIV on Black communities. When we work to overcome structural barriers to HIV testing, prevention, and treatment, we can #StopHIVTogether. #NBHAAD https://t.co/owAYwkPcw3

For Joshua, his family, and for families across the US, we need to lower prescription drug prices. I agree with @POTUS that we must cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month and allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices.

Toxic exposure is a cost of war. 

That’s why I’m proud to support @RepMarkTakano’s Honoring our PACT Act, which will provide healthcare to over 3.5 million toxic-exposed veterans and create a presumption of service connection for 23 respiratory illnesses and cancers. https://t.co/sMRhOmkrri

Huge wins for #MI14 in the government funding legislation that we passed last night! I secured 10 community projects which will strengthen our water systems, support our small businesses and hospitals, and improve community spaces. Learn more here: https://t.co/ZeeKPaZd4U https://t.co/t9PMdM1RW9

I fought hard to pass a budget that reflects the needs & priorities of Michiganders. I’m proud to say that this bill includes all 10 Community Project Funding Requests for #MI14 which will strengthen our water systems, support hospitals & small biz, and improve community spaces. https://t.co/5AiJ1xUUq6

Today, we’re celebrating the 12th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act and how it has lowered costs, expanded coverage, and delivered lifesaving protections. Thanks to the ACA, more Americans than ever before have coverage. Learn more at https://t.co/qram1bedf9. #ThxACA https://t.co/Cw6CYnjAbp

30+ million Americans have health care coverage because of the Affordable Care Act. As a result of @POTUS’ Executive Order today to strengthen the #ACA, nearly a million Americans will see lower premiums & hundreds of thousands of uninsured Americans will gain affordable coverage

Republican leaders don't want to focus on the substance of striking down #RoeVWade, because they know how devastating this will be for women & families across the US. It's more than just about abortion access; it's about reproductive healthcare & freedom. https://t.co/ogTy689uTS

I received a breakthrough positive COVID-19 test result. I have mild, flu-like symptoms, and I’m incredibly grateful to be vaccinated and boosted because I know this could have been much worse. I am quarantining at home and will continue to do the People’s work virtually, (1/2)

Today, @OversightDems held a hearing to examine the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn #RoevWade.

The right to an abortion is a fundamental freedom that protects a deeply personal decision. I will not let anyone tell me that abortion care is not healthcare. https://t.co/W9PdJCb0nK

Today, I was proud to vote for two critical bills that would protect a woman’s right to choose and those who cross state lines to access abortion care. 

📢 ABORTION CARE IS HEALTHCARE 📢 https://t.co/CL9dMoOE4k

✅$3.7B to help schools reopen more safely
✅$12.5B in direct payments to working families 
✅117,000 children lifted out of poverty 
✅63,000 people gained health insurance

We will NOT go back to the 1930s. 

Today, and every day, I will fight to restore access to abortion nationwide so that women and families in Michigan and across this country can decide what is best for their life, health, and future.

Insulin costs $10 to make but it’s priced at nearly $300. 

Today, 43 Senate Republicans voted against a $35 cap on insulin for private insurance holders.

How can Republicans say they want to lower costs for American families?

.@HouseDemocrats have been fighting nonstop to lower costs for families in Michigan and across this nation. That is why today we are passing the #InflationReductionAct — a historic bill to lower health care costs, cut prescription drug prices, and lower the cost of energy.

It's official! @POTUS signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law. Democrats delivered. This law will lower health care costs, cut prescription drug prices, and reduce utility fees to make a real difference in the lives of the People. This is a win for Michigan and for America.🎉

Thanks to @HouseDemocrats, the Inflation Reduction Act makes historic strides in lowering health care costs. Now, @HHSGov can now negotiate the price of high-cost prescription drugs and cap out-of-pocket costs. https://t.co/7Nh1AXhupV

I am dedicated to improving maternal health in my community and across the country. Let’s celebrate Black Breastfeeding Week, which raises awareness of the importance of breastfeeding to help improve maternal health.

On #WomensEqualityDay, we commemorate the anniversary and passage of the 19th Amendment. But this year, SCOTUS took away our constitutional right to reproductive health care. Today and always, I will support equality for all across Michigan and this country. The work continues. https://t.co/yNNdHTHqBO
Attention! Important🧵by @DTE_Energy for all Michiganders. Please exercise caution as @DTE_Energy begin assessing and fixing damages caused by yesterday's storms.

📢Every American deserves high quality health care.

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, families in my district and across America will soon see more affordable prescription drugs for Medicare recipients and lower health insurance premiums.
